reason: Consequence of tokens-group-island-focus-ring (tokens.json): the [role=group] and [role=search] focus ring inside a nested data-theme island whose scheme differs from the page uses the island's scheme color instead of the page's. 2.1.1 fixed the ring color in the root's scheme; light-dark() resolves it per element. This entry covers a dark island on a light page.
notes: Seed from PLAN. Narrowed in Phase 1: any element carrying data-theme other than the root (the seed only matched div), and only the states that focus a control inside the group (hover never does). Review round 2 pinned both values to the single-ring shape (a color, three zero offsets and a spread in px). Phase 2 fix round 1 split the entry by island scheme (this one: the group's nearest island is dark, on the light and theme-light legs; group-island-focus-ring-style-light-island is the mirror), because light-dark() changes nothing in an island whose scheme equals the page's. The :not() drops a group whose nearer island is light inside a dark one (tokens-schemes.html dark-light), a same-scheme island on these legs. Both values now exclude the transparent zero-spread no-ring value, so a dropped ring is not registered. Phase 2 fix round 2 limited the spread on both sides to 1px or more and under 3px: the rings are 0.0625rem (--femto-group-box-shadow-focus-with-input) and --femto-outline-width, 0.125rem (with-button), so 1px to 1.3125px and 2px to 2.625px over the 100% to 131.25% root font sizes, and every record seen keeps the same spread on both sides (p2-grouploading-verify1-noseed-1: 1px, 1.25px, 2px or 2.5px). The schema cannot tie the two spreads together, so a spread change that stays inside that range is still absorbed. where.states is focus only and where.pages the three pages whose focused island groups differ, the only ones p2-grouploading-review-noseed-1 reported (176 records, all focus; layout-elements.html focuses only .secondary and .contrast buttons in its island groups, whose ring 2.1.1 already declares on the group). A group three islands deep (dark, light, dark) is not matched; no fixture focuses one.
